dialogue.origin: （今日は宜しくお願い致します。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for coming in today. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。いらして下さり、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: (遅くなり、すみません。始めてください)
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry I'm late. Please go ahead and start.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: (初めていただいて大丈夫です)
dialogue.content: (It's fine to start now.)

dialogue.origin: すみません、遅くなりました。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.

dialogue.origin: 相談員です。最初に、ご年齢・性別・相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 22才女性 会社のこと
dialogue.content: I'm a 22-year-old female, and it's about my work.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。会社のことでお悩みなのですね?
dialogue.content: Thank you. You're having difficulties related to work, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 具体的に、何にお困りでしょう?
dialogue.content: More specifically, what are you struggling with?

dialogue.origin: 毎日しんどくてどうしたらいいか分かりません
dialogue.content: Every day feels exhausting, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。お辛いですよね。何のお仕事をしていらっしゃるのか、教えて頂けますか?
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very difficult. Could you tell me what kind of work you do?

dialogue.origin: 事務です
dialogue.content: I do administrative work.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。お仕事を始めて、何年くらいでしょう?
dialogue.content: Thank you. How many years have you been at this job?

dialogue.origin: 3年目です
dialogue.content: This is my third year.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。おつらい…とのことですが、何がおつらいのか、教えて頂けますか?
dialogue.content: I understand. You mentioned it's been hard—could you tell me what feels most difficult for you?

dialogue.origin: 同期との関係です
dialogue.content: It's my relationships with my peers who started at the same time as me.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。人間関係でなやまれていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you're struggling with workplace relationships.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 毎日しんどいです
dialogue.content: It's exhausting every day.

dialogue.origin: 毎日だと大変ですよね。同期の方とは、特定の方でしょうか?
dialogue.content: That sounds really tough day after day. Is it with a particular peer?

dialogue.origin: だいたいみんなです
dialogue.content: It's pretty much all of them.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…。どのような関係なのでしょう?
dialogue.content: I see... What is the relationship like with them now?

dialogue.origin: 今は話すことは無くなりました
dialogue.content: We don't talk anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。寂しいお気持ちでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see. Do you feel lonely about that?

dialogue.origin: いえ、寂しくはありません
dialogue.content: No, I don't feel lonely.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。いつ頃から話をしなくなったのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see. About when did you stop talking?

dialogue.origin: 3ヶ月前くらいです
dialogue.content: About three months ago.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…。何かきっかけのようなものがあったのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see... Was there something that triggered it?

dialogue.origin: 1番仲の良かった子に無視みたいな事をされるようになりました。
dialogue.content: The colleague I was closest with started more or less ignoring me.

dialogue.origin: それはひどいですね。その時、どのようなお気持ちだったのでしょう?
dialogue.content: That's awful. How did you feel when that happened?

dialogue.origin: その時は悲しかったです
dialogue.content: At the time, I felt sad.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。ショックですよね。今はどのようなお気持ちでしょう?
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been a shock. How are you feeling now?

dialogue.origin: 腹立たしさの方が大きいです
dialogue.content: Now, I feel more anger than anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。怒りの方が大きくなって。無視をされた理由として、何か思い当たることはおありでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see. So the anger has grown stronger. Do you have any idea why she started ignoring you?

dialogue.origin: はい彼女の事を思って言ったことが、多分気に入らなかったんだと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes. I said something out of concern for her, and I think she probably didn't like it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね…。相談者様が相手のことを思ってのことだったのですよね…。
dialogue.content: I see... So you said it out of concern for her well-being...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それから何も言わずに、今の状態が続いています
dialogue.content: And ever since then, without her saying anything, this situation has just continued.

dialogue.origin: 私が聞いても、何も無いと言われます
dialogue.content: Even when I ask her, she just says nothing's wrong.

dialogue.origin: 毎日しんどいです
dialogue.content: It's exhausting every day.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。そのことで怒っているのかどうか、相手の方に確認も出来ない状態なのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you're in a situation where you can't even confirm with her if that's what she's angry about.

dialogue.origin: 何も言ってくれないので
dialogue.content: Because she won't tell me anything.

dialogue.origin: 親しかった方にそのようにされては、苦しいお気持ちかと思います。
dialogue.content: Being treated that way by someone you were close to must be very painful.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: It makes me angry.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。何か言ってもらった方が、すっきりしますよね。
dialogue.content: I agree. It would be better if she just said something so you could clear the air, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: 卑怯だと思います
dialogue.content: I think it's cowardly.

dialogue.origin: 私は何も悪い事をしていないのに
dialogue.content: Even though I didn't do anything wrong.

dialogue.origin: そのように思われるのですね。原因が分からないと、相談者様もどのようにしたらよいか分からないですよね。
dialogue.content: I understand why you feel that way. If you don't know the cause, it's difficult to know what you should do, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: もういいです
dialogue.content: I'm done with it.

dialogue.origin: どうでもいいです
dialogue.content: I don't care anymore.

dialogue.origin: 相手の方にいったこととは、どのようなことでしょう?もし、差し支えなければ。
dialogue.content: What was it that you said to her, if you don't mind my asking?

dialogue.origin: 二股してたので、それはダメなんじゃない？と
dialogue.content: She was two-timing someone, so I said to her, "That's not right, is it?"

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。本当に相手の方を思っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You were truly concerned about her.

dialogue.origin: それなのに、なんで私がしんどい思いをしないといけないんですか？
dialogue.content: So why am I the one who has to suffer like this?

dialogue.origin: そのように思われるのも無理はありません。相談者様はお優しい方なのですね。
dialogue.content: It's understandable that you feel that way. You're a very kind person.

dialogue.origin: 優しいんでしょうか
dialogue.content: Am I kind, though?

dialogue.origin: 相手にとったら嫌だったんだと思います
dialogue.content: I think from her perspective, it was unpleasant.

dialogue.origin: そのように思われるのですね。お相手の方と、これからどのような関係だといいでしょう?
dialogue.content: I hear you. What kind of relationship would you like to have with her going forward?

dialogue.origin: どうでもいいです
dialogue.content: I don't care.

dialogue.origin: 今、おつらいお気持ちでいらっしゃるのであれば、他の第三者を介して、話をしたいと伝えてはどうでしょう?
dialogue.content: If you're feeling so distressed right now, how about asking a third party to convey to her that you'd like to talk?

dialogue.origin: 話したくありません
dialogue.content: I don't want to talk to her.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お手紙で相談者様のお気持ちを伝えてはどうでしょう?
dialogue.content: I see. How about expressing your feelings in a letter?

dialogue.origin: 関わりたくないので
dialogue.content: Because I don't want to have anything to do with her.

dialogue.origin: どうして私がしんどい思いをしないといけないんですか？
dialogue.content: Why do I have to be the one to suffer?

dialogue.origin: 相談者様が正しいことをされたのに、しんどいのは理不尽ですよね。相手の方以外の方々とも、お話しされていないのですか?
dialogue.content: It feels unreasonable that you're the one suffering when you did the right thing, doesn't it? Are you not talking with your other peers either?

dialogue.origin: 他の同期にもよそよそしくされています
dialogue.content: My other peers are being distant toward me, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。嫌なお気持ちでしょうか。その理由は何でしょう?
dialogue.content: I see. That must feel unpleasant. What do you think is the reason for that?

dialogue.origin: その子が同期の中心的な感じだったのと、自分の言いように言うのが上手いんだと思います
dialogue.content: She was sort of the central figure among our peers, and I think she's good at spinning things to her own advantage.

dialogue.origin: 言い→良い
dialogue.content: (Correction: The character for 'saying' should be the one for 'good/favorable'.)

dialogue.origin: それは勝手なはなしですよね。相談者様は同期の方々に誤解されているかもしれないのですね?
dialogue.content: That sounds very self-serving of her, doesn't it? It seems your peers may have misunderstood the situation.

dialogue.origin: 聞けていないので分かりませんが、同期以外の人から、私の事悪く言ってると聞きました
dialogue.content: I haven't asked them directly so I'm not sure, but I heard from someone who isn't one of our peers that she's been badmouthing me.

dialogue.origin: それは悲しくなりますよね。それでも相手の方と以前は仲良しだったのですね?
dialogue.content: That would make anyone feel sad. And despite all this, you used to be close friends with her, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: だから、余計に腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: That's why it makes me even angrier.

dialogue.origin: 私に直接言えばいいのに
dialogue.content: She should just say it to my face.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。それで、今は関わりたくない、というお気持ちなのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand. And that's why you now feel that you don't want to have anything to do with her.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もし、可能であれば、違う部署に配属願いを出すことは可能でしょうか?
dialogue.content: If it's possible, could you request a transfer to a different department?

dialogue.origin: 無理です
dialogue.content: That's impossible.

dialogue.origin: 元々、課は違います
dialogue.content: We're already in different sections.

dialogue.origin: 仕事の話はできます
dialogue.content: We can talk about work.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。お仕事には支障ないのですね。どなたか職場内でそのことを相談できる方はいらっしゃいますか?
dialogue.content: I see. So it doesn't interfere with your work. Is there anyone at your workplace you can talk to about this?

dialogue.origin: います
dialogue.content: Yes, there is.

dialogue.origin: どなたでしょう?
dialogue.content: Who would that be?

dialogue.origin: 同期ではないけど、歳が近くてその事も話しました
dialogue.content: She's not one of my peers, but she's close to my age, and I've talked to her about this.

dialogue.origin: その子から、私の事悪く言ってるって聞きました
dialogue.content: She's the one who told me that my peer has been badmouthing me.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。毎日、つらくいら立つお気持ちでいらっしゃるのですね。それでも今のお仕事は続けていきたいとおもっていらっしゃるのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see. So you're feeling distressed and irritated every day. In spite of that, do you still want to continue with your current job?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私が辞めるのはおかしいと思ってます
dialogue.content: I think it would be wrong for me to be the one to quit.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。相談者様はお気持ちの強い方なのですね。今の人間関係でも続けていけそうでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I agree. You're a person with strong convictions. Do you think you can continue on with the current relationship dynamics?

dialogue.origin: 強くは無いのでしんどいです
dialogue.content: I'm not strong, so it's exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 続けるつもりです
dialogue.content: But I intend to continue.

dialogue.origin: そうお考えなのですね。何か気分転換できそうなことはおありでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see that's your intention. Is there anything you can do to take your mind off things?

dialogue.origin: 仕事に言っていない時は楽しい事もあります
dialogue.content: When I'm not at work, there are things I enjoy.

dialogue.origin: 友達もいるので
dialogue.content: I have friends, so...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。良かったです。お友達にも相談する等して、今の状況を何とか乗り切ることが出来たら、と思います。
dialogue.content: I see, that's good to hear. I hope that by talking with your friends, you'll be able to get through this current situation.

dialogue.origin: 乗り切るっていつまでですか？
dialogue.content: 'Get through this'... For how long?

dialogue.origin: 具体的には分かりませんが、人の気持ちは時間と共に変わるのだと思います。相手の方もずっと同じ気持ちでいるのはしんどいのでは、と思います。
dialogue.content: I can't say for sure, but I believe people's feelings change over time. I imagine it must be difficult for her, too, to hold onto the same feelings forever.

dialogue.origin: それは私には分からないです
dialogue.content: I wouldn't know about that.

dialogue.origin: でも、毎日しんどいのはどうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: But what should I do about feeling exhausted every day?

dialogue.origin: 我慢しないといけませんか？
dialogue.content: Do I just have to endure it?

dialogue.origin: 相手は同期をみんな味方にしてるので、しんどくないんじゃないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: She has all our peers on her side, so she's probably not suffering, is she?

dialogue.origin: しんどい気持ちを、お仕事に向けて頑張る、というのはどうでしょう?
dialogue.content: How about trying to channel these difficult feelings into your work?

dialogue.origin: 無理です
dialogue.content: That's impossible.

dialogue.origin: しんどいのに仕事頑張れますか？
dialogue.content: How can I possibly work hard when I'm this exhausted?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。相手の方は嫌なことを言われた分、怒りが大きかったので、周りを巻き込んでいるようですが、楽しくは無いと思われます。
dialogue.content: You're right. It seems her anger over what you said was so great that she's now involving those around her, but I doubt she's enjoying the situation either.

dialogue.origin: 周りをまきこむ？私がですか？
dialogue.content: Involving others? Are you talking about me?

dialogue.origin: すみません、誤解させるような表現でした。そうではなくて、お相手の彼女の方が、です。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, my phrasing was misleading. I meant her, not you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Oh, okay.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: 申し訳ありません、もっとお話をお聴きしたいのですが、お時間となりましたが、続けますか?
dialogue.content: I'm very sorry, and I would like to hear more, but it seems our time for today is up. Would you like to continue?

dialogue.origin: いいです
dialogue.content: No, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: お力になれずすみません。良ければまた、お話ししにいらして下さい。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help today. Please feel free to come and talk again if you'd like.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: これで終了させて頂いてよろしいですか?
dialogue.content: Is it all right if we end the session here?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much.)

topic.sub: 同期との人間関係の悪化
